scenarios.name: Navigate to client registration page
scenarios.criteria: Clicking 'Join Healing Sky' and selecting 'Join as a Client' opens the client registration page.

scenarios.name: Fill client registration fields except phone number
scenarios.criteria: After filling the specified fields and setting the date of birth, all fields retain their values, and the dropdowns show the correct date.
scenarios.endState: Client registration form shows filled details for Name, Email, Address, Referral Code, and Date of Birth.

scenarios.name: Complete client registration with phone number
scenarios.criteria: After entering the phone number and clicking submit, registration succeeds if 'Registration completed successfully' or the client login page is displayed.
preconditions: Client registration form shows filled details for Name, Email, Address, Referral Code, and Date of Birth.
scenarios.startState: Client registration form shows filled details for Name, Email, Address, Referral Code, and Date of Birth.
scenarios.endState: Either registration success message is displayed, or the client login page is displayed.

scenarios.name: Navigate to client sign-in page and proceed to OTP verification
scenarios.criteria: Using the configured client email and selecting Email as OTP delivery, clicking Log in navigates to the OTP verification screen.
scenarios.endState: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.

scenarios.name: Complete OTP verification to authenticate client
scenarios.criteria: Entering the configured OTP bypass value and submitting verifies the OTP, displays the success message, and navigates to the authenticated client dashboard.
preconditions: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.
scenarios.endState: Client is authenticated, and the dashboard is displayed.

scenarios.name: Log out and return to the homepage
scenarios.criteria: Clicking the profile avatar or account menu, selecting log out, and confirming returns the client to the homepage with the Log in option visible.
preconditions: Client dashboard is displayed for an authenticated client.
scenarios.startState: Client dashboard is displayed for an authenticated client.
scenarios.endState: Healing Sky homepage is displayed with Log in option visible.
